1.title: LA Clippers fined $30m by NBA over Leonard deal
1.summary: The LA Clippers are fined $30m (£22.2m) by the NBA for violating salary rules over the acquisition of star player Kawhi Leonard.

2.title: Man Is Rescued From Inside Garbage Truck in San Francisco
2.summary: The city’s Fire Department said it received a call just after 4 a.m. on Wednesday reporting that a person was stuck in the vehicle after it collected trash from a dumpster.

3.title: Deadlocked Jury in Lindsay Clancy Trial Again Says It Can’t Reach a Verdict
3.summary: Jurors say they cannot reach a unanimous agreement after about 30 hours of deliberations. The judge is bringing them back for one last try.

4.title: Protests in Spain over government's handling of Ceuta migrant crisis
4.summary: Spanish opposition parties accuse Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez of abandoning the residents of Ceuta.

5.title: Uber shuts operations in Nigeria and Uganda with immediate effect
5.summary: Nigeria - Africa's most populous country - is proving a tough market for ride-hailing services.

6.title: Watch: Jury still unable to reach unanimous decision in Lindsay Clancy case
6.summary: For a second time in two days, jurors told the judge they could not agree on a verdict in the murder trial.
